title: 建築設計演習Ⅰ
subtitle: Architectural Design Practice I
keywords: Architectural Design 2.Spatial Composition and Regional Cooperation 3.Architectural Features 4.Architectural Drafting 5.Presentation of Drafting
educationalGoal: You will be able to learn the design method and drafting for small-scale buildings, and also develop the ability to summarize and present your ideas. First, you need to understand the surrounding environment of the target site set in cooperation with the area. Next, you design your intended architectural space based on the conditions such as the architectural use, function, composition, beauty, and measurable shape of the subject. The basic contents of the design must be represented in draftings and the like.
advice: This learning is the first step in architectural design. The first project is the design of a "cafe" with a single function. The second project is the design of the "house", the most well-known architecture. ○projectI "Cafe": ○projectⅡ “House”: Explanation of project Explanation of project Lecture on related contents Lecture on related contents Esquisse Esquisse Teaching materials: Distribute prints for each project and add explanations.
books: Textbooks: “Architectural Works 2026” Kanazawa Institute of Technology, “3rd Collection of Compact Architectural Design Documents” Maruzen-pub.co. Reference Books:“Revised Edition Architectural Drawing for Masterpiece Houses”Gakugei-pub.co., “Architectural Drafting for Beginning Students, 3rd ed.”ichigaya-pub.co., Reserved Books: Not specified
requiredKnowledge: It is important familiar accustomed to architecture. It is important to get the pleasure of creating your own work. Let's go to actually see the new architecture that has been talked about. Habit of reading architecture magazines is important. It is important to always think about architecture. Sketch when you come up with something on a daily basis. It is important to increase opportunities to move your hands. It is important to discuss with fellow each other. It is also important to help senior class architectural drafting.

activityGoals.body: Understand the conditions of use, function, configuration, beauty, etc. required for architectural design.
The design image and concept can be clearly shown. You can design as an integrated architecture.
The basic contents that the architecture and the district should have can be expressed by draftings.
Esquisse steps and assignment submissions can proceed according to the schedule.
As a basis for future architectural design 2, etc., basic design techniques can be acquired.

achievementLevels.ideal: In addition to the basic functions as an architectural space, the theme and ingenuity that bring out charm and comfort are included. Even in drafting expressions including architectural perspectives, presentations that give beauty and impression to viewers have been achieved.
achievementLevels.standard: In addition to satisfying the basic functions of the architectural space, efforts and ideas that lead to charm and comfort are recognized. The drafting expression, including architectural perspectives, has also achieved perfection that is easy for viewers to understand.
